title: Claude Code workflow best practices: 6 tips
description:
Claude Code workflow best practices start with planning before coding and keeping project context in CLAUDE.md. Use Plan mode so Claude shows a full plan before writing code, then approve the approach before edits begin. Run parallel Claude Code sessions with git worktrees, add slash commands like a custom /btw for repeated tasks, and use subagents for harder work and code review. This Claude Code setup also includes running checks and confirming the build works before you trust the result.
#ssktechy
